hex 0.5.2-dbg: DEBUG RELEASE. This lane ships one purpose-built debug command and is slated for removal in v0.6.0, which will cut it out entirely; do not build on it.

hex 0.5.0: Phase 6: the social layer. Chat shapes and the monitor strings stay wire-checkable for tonight's capture; everything else is tt_dw-faithful port.
